settings.title: Amasethingi
auth.checkInbox: Hlola i-imeyili yakho uthole isihlanganisi sokusetha kabutjha iphasiwedi.
auth.landingLesson: Iimfundo ezifitjhani zokuthi imali isebenza njani lapha.
auth.errorCredentials: I-imeyili namkha iphasiwedi ayikalungi. Sibawa ulinge godu.
auth.errorPasswordLen: Iphasiwedi kufanele ibe namatshwayo okungasenani ayi-8.
onboarding.writeOrSkip: Tlola umnqopho lowo, namkha weqe kwanje.
onboarding.goalOtherHint: Tlola umnqopho wakho: isib. ukubulungela ifundo yomntwanami
goals.pickerBody: Sizakubeka phambili iimfundo ezikhambisana nalokho ofuna ukukufikelela.
auth.clickLink: Qhwarhaza isihlanganisi esiku-imeyili leyo ukuvula i-akhawunti yakho. Hlola ifolda ye-spam nawungayiboniko.
auth.linkedinBody: Ibhrawuza ye-LinkedIn ivimba i-Google. Sebenzisa i-Apple, i-Facebook, i-imeyili, namkha ukopulule isihlanganisi usivule ku-Chrome namkha ku-Safari.
auth.landingTagline: Iimfundo zemali ezitlolelwe iSewula Afrika. Ama-payslip, ama-debit order, SARS, TFSAs.
auth.landingBudget: Faka isitatimende. Sisifunda kumemori begodu asilibulungi ifayili.
auth.errorDisposable: Sibawa uzitlolise ngesiphande se-imeyili samambala. Ama-imeyili wesikhatjhana awavunyelwa.
onboarding.usernameBody: Kuyafuneka. Leli ligama lakho elibonwa mphakathi: awukwazi ukukweqa.
onboarding.usernameRules: Amatshwayo ayi-3–20: amaledere, iinomboro, amatshwayo wokuthalela.
onboarding.errMin: Igama lomsebenzisi kufanele libe namatshwayo okungasenani ayi-3.
onboarding.errMax: Igama lomsebenzisi kufanele libe namatshwayo ayi-20 namkha ngaphasi.
onboarding.errChars: Sebenzisa amaledere amancani, iinomboro namatshwayo wokuthalela kwaphela.
onboarding.goalBody: Akukateleli. Khetha umnqopho munye namkha eminengi yemali, namkha weqe ubeke lokhu ngokukhamba kwesikhathi kuthebhu yeMinqopho.
settings.draftNotice: Amatjhugululo enziwe ngomtjhini asalinde ukubuyekezwa babantu. Omunye umtlolo usesiNgisini.
